rationale.edition: All changed paths (web/src/plugins/logs/Index.vue, web/src/plugins/logs/IndexList.vue, web/src/locales/languages/en.json) are under web/src/ — the OSS frontend tree. No enterprise directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, etc.) are touched, and no enterprise keywords (SSO, SAML, RBAC, SDR, cipher) appear in the paths or symbol names. This is a pure OSS change.
rationale.skip: The change is not skipped. The trigger comment is empty (no explicit skip/opt-out), and the diff modifies user-facing UI in web/src/plugins/logs/: it moves the LogsNoStreamState earlier in the conditional chain, replaces a static text empty state with interactive OEmptyState + quick-pick stream buttons, and adds new i18n keys. This is an active UI behavior change — not docs/CI/comments-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff introduces (1) a reordered conditional in Index.vue that surfaces the no-stream state before error/loading branches, and (2) quick-pick stream buttons in IndexList.vue rendered inside OEmptyState with data-test anchors (logs-search-stream-quick-pick, logs-search-stream-quick-pick-more). Both are user-exercisable UI flows that need verification: the no-stream state must appear correctly when streams exist but none is selected, and clicking a quick-pick button must select the stream and load its fields.
rationale.area: All changed files live in web/src/plugins/logs/ — the Logs plugin. The feature is about the logs page's empty/no-stream state and stream-selection UX. Sibling specs in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/ (logspage.spec.js, logstable.spec.js, shareLink.spec.js, etc.) exercise similar logs-page interactions, making Logs the correct area.
rationale.group: Logs-Core is the best fit. This group already contains the foundational logs-page specs (logspage.spec.js, logstable.spec.js, logsqueries.spec.js) that test the main logs view. The quick-pick feature is a core page interaction (not a query-builder feature like Logs-Builder-Basic/Advanced, and not a standalone feature like Logs-Features). Placing it here keeps it co-located with the existing logs page infrastructure tests.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The diff only touches web/src/plugins/logs/*.vue and web/src/locales/languages/en.json — none of which are under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. No pre-existing E2E coverage for this feature was added by the author.
